name: MLPerf v6.0 Jetson AGX Thor: llama3.1-8b-edge SingleStream TPOT p90 9.81 ms
unit: ms, 90th-percentile time per output token, per query (SingleStream, concurrency 1)
methodology: MLPerf Inference open-division submission, 1x NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit 128GB (unified memory), TensorRT 10.8, CUDA 12.8. Quoted verbatim from performance/run_1/mlperf_log_summary.txt, Result is VALID. v6.0, llama3.1-8b-edge, FP4 weights, SingleStream, concurrency 1. '90.00 percentile time to output token (ns): 9810269' = 9.81 ms. Per-token latency inside one request, not aggregate. Mean TPOT on the same log is 8.01 ms.
notes: Open division. v5.1's p90 TPOT for the same scenario was 21.64 ms; both are kept because the submissions do not document what changed.
